newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson-CSF wins Sarajevo airport deal.
newsitem.headline: Thomson-CSF wins Sarajevo airport deal.

text.p: French electronics firm Thomson-CSF said on Monday its Airsys subsidiary won a contract to supply navigation and landing aids for Sarajevo airport.
The company, which signed the contract with the civil aviation authorities of Bosnia and Herzegovina, will install the equipment between October and December this year.
The system will allow the reopening of Sarajevo airport to commercial aircraft, marking "an essential step in the country's economic reconstruction," Thomson-CSF said in a statement.
A company spokeswoman declined to give price details.
